About Daniel Wyatt

I've spent 20 years working in finance in London, in debt purchasing, complaints handling and credit control for a consumer loan company, and I've also trained and managed teams of new starters. That means I've seen money matters from both sides: how businesses and regulators talk, and how hard that language can be for the people on the receiving end.

I built this site to close that gap. Making Tax Digital is a big change for landlords and sole traders, and most of what's written about it is either jargon or a sales pitch. Here you'll get plain English, the facts checked against GOV.UK and the software providers' own websites, and a clear way to compare your options.

I use AI to gather and organise the details quickly, but a person always checks the results before anything goes on this site. Where I earn a commission, or could, I'll always tell you. Those products are shown in a labelled Featured section, and the facts about every product are checked the same way.

This site gives general information, not personal tax advice.

What this site is

A plain-English, independent comparison of software HMRC recognises for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, built from HMRC's own list and the providers' own websites. It's run by me, Daniel Wyatt, in the UK, and written for UK landlords and sole traders.

What this site isn't

It isn't HMRC, it isn't connected with any government body, and it doesn't give tax advice.
